reason: Batch report on the page and behind the QR code, with a named independent lab, is exactly what I check before buying. At $24.99 for one box, with an empty-box refund, I would try it once.
objection: I only believe the testing if I can open the report, see the lab's name, and see that the batch number matches the box. Also it is made in China and sold on TikTok Shop, and my drawer is already full of half-used bottles.
would_change_my_mind: If the report did not open, was not for the batch number on the box, or the lab turned out to be unknown or not independent, I would not buy.
